name: Double Island Point
bio_variants: Cooloola headland with an 1884 lighthouse and a right-hand surf break on its northern side.
Headland north of Noosa topped by an 1884 timber lighthouse, reached on foot from the beach.
Beach headland 12 km south of Rainbow Beach township, with an 1884 lighthouse to walk up to.
notes: Hours are an estimate (walk length unverified). Permit fee deliberately not stated.

name: South Molle Island
bio_variants: Hilly Whitsunday island with about 16 km of walking tracks, reached by boat.
Whitsunday island of national park walking tracks, including the Mount Jeffreys climb, reached by boat.
Boat-access Whitsunday island with national park tracks and a 194 m high point.
notes: Estimate from Mount Jeffreys walk (about 1 hr one-way from Bauer Bay). No resort or jetty promised.

name: Castle Hill
bio_variants: Pink granite monolith 286 m above Townsville, with a summit lookout and views toward Magnetic Island.
Heritage-listed granite hill over the city, climbed by the 758-step Goat Track or by road.
Townsville's 286 m pink granite landmark, reached by a 2.6 km road or a stair path to the top.

name: Museum of Tropical Queensland
bio_variants: Free museum of North Queensland natural history, with galleries on rainforests, reefs and HMS Pandora.
Tropical museum galleries on rainforests, reefs and HMS Pandora, sent to capture the Bounty mutineers.
Free general entry to galleries on World Heritage rainforests, reefs and HMS Pandora.
notes: Museum now trades as Queensland Museum Tropics (renaming is an owner call). Free claim is for general entry only.

name: Maritime Museum of Townsville
bio_variants: Maritime museum on Palmer Street in South Townsville, run by Townsville Maritime Museum Ltd.
South Townsville museum on Palmer Street devoted to the city's maritime history.
notes: Research gave no verified description of the collection, so bios stay thin; a distinctive fact is needed before this ships.

name: The Palmetum
bio_variants: Council botanic garden of palms only, about 300 species across 17 hectares.
Free botanic garden in Townsville devoted to palms, with a Japanese Tokuyama Garden.
Palm-only botanic garden opened in 1988, with the Licuala Walk and Tokuyama Garden.

name: Army Museum North Queensland
bio_variants: North Queensland military history museum at the centre of Jezzine Barracks on Kissing Point.
Free museum in Kissing Point's Jezzine Barracks precinct on North Queensland military history.
notes: No opening days stated; third parties suggest limited days, left out of bios.

name: Billabong Sanctuary
bio_variants: Wildlife sanctuary at Nome, 17 km south of Townsville, with paid koala and python photos.
11-hectare wildlife sanctuary 17 km south of Townsville, with photo experiences with koalas and crocodiles.

name: Wallaman Falls
bio_variants: Australia's tallest single-drop waterfall, a 268 m plunge in Girringun National Park.
A 268 m horsetail drop on Stony Creek, with a 20 m deep plunge pool, in the Wet Tropics.
268 m waterfall in the Wet Tropics World Heritage area, with a lookout and picnic tables.
notes: Djinda walk closure 9-20 Nov 2026 per a park alert (unverified).
